diagnosis.summary: The nightly run b8001003 for 2026-10-01 failed in `transform` because fct_orders now points at `o.order_total`, a column that doesn't exist in stg_orders (stg_orders already exposes it as order_amount). fct_orders is the only model that differs from the deployed version, and the upstream data for the day is fine. Proposed fix: revert fct_orders to the deployed version and rerun.

root_cause.explanation: An undeployed edit to fct_orders changed `o.order_amount` to `o.order_total as order_amount`. stg_orders already renames the contract column order_total to order_amount, so stg_orders has no order_total column and DuckDB throws a Binder Error, which fails dbt build.

evidence.claim: Run b8001003 passed ingest and failed in transform: dbt build had 1 failure and 2 skipped
fct_orders errored with a Binder Error: no column named order_total in stg_orders
fct_orders is the only changed model; the diff swaps o.order_amount for o.order_total
stg_orders has an order_amount column and no order_total column
The landing file matches the contract (no missing or extra columns, no parse problems), so upstream is not the cause
The runbook says to revert the model that changed

alternatives_considered: Upstream renamed a column (fix with apply_column_mapping): ruled out because the landing header matches the contract and ingest succeeded
A stg_orders change broke the mart: ruled out because only fct_orders is changed
Transient failure (rerun_only): ruled out because the Binder Error is deterministic
The change is intentional, so escalate to analytics_engineering: unlikely, because the edit only renames a column into the name it already had and has no working business-logic purpose

proposal.rationale: fct_orders is the only model that differs from the deployed version. The edit swapped `o.order_amount` for `o.order_total as order_amount`, but stg_orders has no order_total column (stg_orders already renames the contract column order_total to order_amount), so DuckDB throws a Binder Error. Ingest succeeded and the landing file matches the contract, so the data is fine. Reverting fct_orders to the deployed version brings back the working column reference.

applied: reverted models/marts/fct_orders.sql to the deployed version
